samples.title: Alfred Barye
samples.excerpt:
Alfred Barye "Le Fils" ma ọ bụ Alf Barye (Paris, France, 21 Jenụwarị 1839 - Paris, France, 1882) bụ onye France na-ese ihe, nke Belle Époque, nwa akwụkwọ nke nna ya onye na-ese egwu Antoine-Louis Barye. Alfred Barye rụrụ arụmụka nke nna ya, Antoine-Louis Barye, maka ọtụtụ afọ, n'enweghị ike itinye aha ya nkeonwe. Ọnọdụ a gara n'ihu ruo mgbe e mepụtara ịkpaghasị n'etiti ha.
Site na imekọ ihe ọnụ ya na Émile-Coriolan Guillemin, Barye mere ihe osise maka "The Arab Warrior Knight on Horseback". N'ime Ọrụ Barye bụ ọla nchara animalier yana isiokwu ndị Ọwụwa Anyanwụ. Kjellberg, Pierre (1994). Bronze

samples.excerpt:
Helen Steven (Amụrụ n'ụbọchị 19 Ọktoba 1942 n'ụbọchị 12 Eprel 2016) bụ onye Quaker na-eme udo na Scotland na otu n'ime ndị guzobere Scottish Center for Nonviolence . E ji onyinye Gandhi International Peace Award kwado mmegide ya megide ọdụ ụgbọ mmiri nuklia dị na Scotland n'afọ 2004.
Steven gụrụ akwụkwọ na Laurel Bank School na Mahadum Glasgow, ma rụọ ọrụ ọtụtụ afọ dị ka onye nkuzi akụkọ ihe mere eme. O wepụtara onwe ya na Peace Corps na Vietnam na mbido afọ 1970, ma chọta mkpebi ya na pacifism na ahụmịhe ya na Vietnam.

samples.title: Mary Renfrew
samples.excerpt:
Mary Josephine Renfrew OBE FRSE (amụrụ n'afọ 1955) bụ onye Britain na-amụ nwa na agụmakwụkwọ.


== Mmụta ==
Renfrew gụsịrị akwụkwọ na Nọọsụ na Mahadum Edinburgh na 1975, na n'ọrụ ịmụ nwa n'otu ụlọ ọrụ ahụ na 1978. O nwetara Ph.D. na inye ara n'afọ 1982, mgbe ọ nọ na ngalaba ọmụmụ nke Medical Research Council na Edinburgh.

samples.title: Ndepụta nri ndị Afrịka
samples.excerpt:
Nke a bụ ndepụta nke nri ndị Afrịka. Nri bụ ụdị ejiji na omenala, nke a na-ejikọkarị ya na omenala a kapịrị ọnụ. Nri dị iche iche nke Africa na-eji ngwakọta nke mkpụrụ osisi, ọka na akwụkwọ nri dị n'ógbè ahụ, yana mmiri ara ehi na anụ. N'akụkụ ụfọdụ nke kọntinent ahụ, nri ọdịnala nwere mmiri ara ehi, curd na ngwaahịa whey. A na-egosipụta ọdịdị dị iche iche nke kọntinent ahụ n'ọtụtụ ụzọ dị iche iche na-eri nri na ịṅụ mmanya, efere, na usoro nkwadebe nke ọtụtụ ndị bi na ya.
